name: Navi
description: The Navi are an ancient race; according to Plymouth, very few remain alive today. A journal described by Sylan reportedly records that the Navi were searching for a child whose mother died while the child survived. Among them, the Mother's Prayer is a sacred tradition—a prophecy they historically used to identify individuals who would aid their exploration and protection of Atlas. Keystone keepers are considered honorary members of the Navi by becoming Children of the Great Eldarin Tree; this honorary membership can be bestowed upon outsiders, and a Child of the Tree is accepted as a brother among them.
